[B]

[Verse 1]
[B]I'm a dreamer,
[F#]a make believer
[G#m]I was told that you were
[E]too
[B]I love the silence
[F#]and the clear horizon
[G#m]And I got that all from you
[E]

[Pre-Chorus]
[F#]Every now and then I'm drawn [G#m]to places
[E]Where I hear your voice or see your face, [G#m]and
[F#]Every little thought will lead [G#m]me right back to
[E]you I was born from

[Chorus]
[B]one love of two hearts We were
[F#]three kids and a loving mum You
[G#m]made this place a home A
[E]shelter from the storm You said I had
[B]one life and a true heart I
[F#]tried my best and I came so far But
[G#m]you will never know 'Cause you
[E]let me walk this road alone
[B]

[F#]will always be you
